- Dry-run (internal): 6:00–6:30pm ET
- Main walkthrough: 6:30–7:30pm ET
If that works, we can do Tue Aug 31 to align with your second option. If you need the later Wed 8:00pm start, say the word and we'll shift resources.

For the dry-run we will have:
- Laura Bennett (owner, Redwood onboarding)
- Ben Carter (security intake lead) — will validate evidence indexing and pen-test handoff
- Kimberly Park (controls SME) — will run control-level Q&A
I've attached a short dry-run runbook and ops bridge notes; these are internal templates meant to speed the pre-call check (runbook-dryrun-template.md, ops-bridge-instructions.txt).

Can you confirm who from FinLedger will join each piece (names + roles) and which of the three slots you prefer? Once you confirm, I'll send calendar invites (we'll include an ops bridge dial-in and a shared Drive folder for evidence transfer).

Thanks,
Laura Bennett
Senior Customer Onboarding Manager
Redwood Inference
